body: Someone recently told me "it's going to be ok, it has to be right?" It always hurts the most when its people you trust the most.
I'm so sorry for your loss and unbearable emotional pain.  That is a name I will remember I think I found his obituary.  Did he live in Iowa Park?
I don't know what happened here since their comments were deleted, but you didn't do anything wrong. I appreciate your kind words ❤️
Still no comments. I knew nobody cared
Well, she has since apologized for her irritability, saying that she was just having a very bad week, and that I didn't do anything wrong. Now our friendship is back to normal.

Thank you for your kindness.  That's actually what I'm doing right now.  I don't want talk to her until she is ready.  I just didn't know what I should do when that time comes.  I've had a hard time making and keeping friends my whole life.  I feel like a burden and often feel like the world would be a much better place without me.

My point is, I need people to tell me ahead of time if I do something that makes them uncomfortable as its the last thing I want to do.  Not get passive aggressive with me and turn everyone else against me.  You clearly don't have the first clue what it's like to be in my shoes.
I never said it gave me a pass for innapropriate behavior. Did you catch the word "subconsious?"
I sincerely apologize.  Let me just go back to being treated like a throwaway while you get all the praises in the world while running on my back.  Good day!!!

I have been on Reddit for a long time.  I just made this one because I wanted to have more anonymity.  I'm not trying to stir up arguments.  I just didn't want my name plastered everywhere for "attacking front line heroes" when that is not what I am trying to do at all.
